fusions.name: Shoe Pitch
fusions.desc: Pitches 3 horseshoes at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Ridden Down
fusions.desc: Only strikes a target at or below 25% health, and that threshold rises with each rank. The blow deals 24 damage and uses up every affliction on the target for 1.5 times the damage they had left to deal.

fusions.name: Breath Between Blows
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Unflagging Arm
fusions.desc: Each blow you land restores 3 stamina. Once every 2 seconds.
